content:
maria: FYI I ran into a production-y bug using the async Python SDK (0.9.1). When a transient 503 occurs the client retries and the consumer sees overlapping chunks (partial text repeated).
jun: ouch. is this streaming or chunked http? can you share a tiny repro?
maria: streaming via client.chat.stream(...). Example behavior: app prints:
'partial: The model says'
'partial: The model says the'
'partial: The model says the model'

where 'The model says' gets replayed instead of continuing.
tyler: that looks like the client is replaying buffered bytes from the previous TCP session rather than resuming at a boundary. probably treating streams like unary responses.
maria: repro script I used:
```py
async def main():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=..., suppress_replay_for_streams=False) as c:
        async for chunk in c.stream(prompt, idempotency_key='op-42'):
            print('partial:', chunk.text)
```
Trigger a 503 in the middle and you'll see duplicates.
jun: which retry/backoff implementation are we using? decorator or inline sleep?
maria: current RetryConfig = {"max_attempts": 3, "backoff": "exp"} and the retry path calls _replay_stream_buffer() on retry.
tyler: suggestion: two orthogonal fixes: (1) make streams non-replayable by default (safety), (2) design a resume token API for safe continuation. Resume token requires server contract changes though.
jun: agree. For (1) we can add client config suppress_replay_for_streams: bool default True. Also log a clear warning when a retry would replay a stream.
maria: For short-term mitigation can we detect "consumer already consumed a chunk" and abort replay with a StreamReplayError so the app can decide to restart?
tyler: yes. Implementation notes: expose RetryPolicy as a Protocol with async def backoff(self, attempt: int) -> float and safe_to_replay_streams: bool. That will make typing cleaner and let users plug custom backoff. Also annotate stream(...) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamChunk, None] in stubs.
jun: +1. Right now many symbols are typed as Any which kills autocompletion. We should add types for StreamChunk with fields: text: str, delta: Dict[str, Any], done: bool.
maria: open PR with a sketch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2501. It adds suppress_replay_for_streams flag, StreamReplayError, and typed RetryPolicy Protocol. devex-bot complained about missing tests.
devex-bot: CI failed on PR #2501: unit tests (streaming_test.py::test_stream_replay_abort) failed (AssertionError).
tyler: I'll pick up the test failure. Two edgecases to cover: (a) buffer replay when consumer hasn't consumed any bytes (safe?), (b) partial-consumed where we must abort. Let's make behavior: abort replay if consumer consumed >0 bytes, otherwise allow replay only when RetryPolicy.safe_to_replay_streams is True.
jun: also add a small example in quickstart showing recommended pattern: either set suppress_replay_for_streams=True or implement resume tokens server-side. The sample should show reconnect logic and idempotency_key usage for side-effects.
maria: Product Q: do we want resume tokens as a medium-term roadmap item? It would let us do cheaper retries without full restart.
tyler: yes but needs server change. add to roadmap and file an RFC (I can draft). For SDK parity we should land Python change and mirror in JS; both should expose RetryPolicy Protocol/Interface and the suppress_replay_for_streams toggle.
jun: followups: tyler -> RFC for resume tokens + tests; maria -> update repro + add flake/tests; devex-bot -> run nightly perf on streaming.
maria: thanks. I'll mark the issue and link PR.
